TEXT: [FI] The day after the hospital visit to Saori. Today is Marine Day, so it's a school holiday.
[FI] I don't have anything in particular to do, so I whiled away my time on the internet.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh, this figure... It greatly rose in value since its release.
[FI] Somehow, I was browsing an auction site, and like always, the auctioneers were waging a fierce battle.
[FI] This plastic model is also one of those that Saori passed to me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Come to think of it, although Saori requested to keep Kirino and Kuroneko in the dark...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Did she get in touch with them?
[FI] Let's think about this logically...
[FI] If she stops contacting them suddenly after she got hospitalized, wouldn't they get suspicious?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Should I try asking them?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] What about Saori?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, did Saori say or do anything strange recently?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Huh? Is that the attitude you should have when asking someone something?
[FI] I want to hit her...!
[FI] But I'll hold back for now. I'll have to act humble for now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Recently, would you have noticed anything strange about Saori?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Hmm... Come to think of it...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] After the Siscaly Tournament, I suddenly received an Avatar Item data from her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Avatar Item?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] To put it simply, it allows you to attach something to your character.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Things like weapons, armor and stuff like special costumes...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh. Is that something great?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] There are a range of good and bad Avatar Items.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] There are some which you can get just by playing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Of course, there are some which are tournament and event exclusives.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] What I received was something that you get only by winning 300 online battles.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Isn't that pretty rare?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] You can say that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Saori said "I don't need it anymore", so I received it with gratitude.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Did you give her anything?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...No.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I also said "Let's trade?", but she didn't want anything...
[FI] ...Isn't that weird?
[FI] Even if they're friends, it's a rare item. It's not something you can just give as a present.
[FI] Has this got something to do with her passing the otaku goods to me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Other than that, I haven't noticed anything...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Then, did Kuroneko mention anything?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Huh? Why do you think I know anything regarding her?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] R-Right!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] If you know that, then don't ask weird questions.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yes...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Well, if something happened, she would tell me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] We're her only friends after all.
[FI] Recently, she's been doing well in school.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Then, was that all?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, I still have one more question.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Well, coming from you, it's probably a pointless question.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] If it is, I'll crush you with my foot.
[FI] Crush where!
[FI] Actually, I didn't ask that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Come on, ask your question already. I don't have that much free time.
[FI] Let's leave it at that after all.
[FI] Right now, I don't think I can get a straight answer out of her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] So? Say it already.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Sorry. It's nothing after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Kay. I'm going then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You don't have to be cold just because I didn't ask.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What does it mean when a girl wants a guy to keep something important for her?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] You don't even know that? Isn't that obvious?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] 【Promise About The Future】, stuff like that right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Promise about the future?
[FI] That's indeed something important that you want a guy to keep.
[FI] I still don't understand, but isn't this answer a little off?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's not something like that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] So irritating...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] If that's wrong, then why don't you go find the answer yourself?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Hey, are you an idiot? Do you want to die?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Haven't you been browsing the net too much...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] When a girl says that she's fine, what does it mean?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Huh? What's that, what do you mean?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Like, when she say "I'm fine now".

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] If she say "I'm fine", it means "Don't get involved any further".

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Is that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] You're involving yourself more than necessary and she thinks, "So annoying".

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I don't really want to hear this...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Be considerate to avoid vexing the other party.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Either that or...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Maybe it's the opposite and she wants you to worry about her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] The opposite?
[FI] When she strongly states that she's fine... It means she wants you to worry about her...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hm... Sorry. I don't get it at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Men who don't understand a maiden's heart should be exterminated!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're going to make me cry!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Yes yes, I'm busy unlike you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] If you still have questions, maybe you could prostrate and ask the person involved?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] *sigh*...
[FI] Feels like the aftermath of a storm.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, thanks to Kirino, I learnt something.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Somehow or another, her words are convincing.
[FI] Saori is indeed hiding something.
